extracted.intended_audience: readers, users, and redistributors of Project Gutenberg electronic works
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and mandatory terms for using, copying, converting, and redistributing Project Gutenberg electronic works (public-domain texts) and the obligations that attach when the Project Gutenberg name/trademark is retained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prominent license sentence on redistributed copies (1.E.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: The following sentence ... must appear prominently whenever any copy of a Project Gutenberg work ... is accessed, displayed, performed, viewed, copied or distributed: "This eBook is for the use of anyone anywhere in the United States and most other parts of the world at no cost and with almost no restrictions whatsoever. You may copy it, give it away or re-use it under the terms of the Project Gutenberg™ License included with this eBook or online at www.gutenberg.org. If you are not located in the United States, you will have to check the laws of the country where you are located before using this eBook."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Must be displayed prominently with active links to the full Project Gutenberg License whenever a Project Gutenberg work (or any work associated with the phrase "Project Gutenberg") is made available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of references allowed only under conditions (1.C)
rubrics_metrics.description: If an individual Project Gutenberg electronic work is derived from texts not protected by U.S. copyright law ... the work can be copied and distributed to anyone in the United States without paying any fees or charges. If an individual work is unprotected by copyright law in the United States and you are located in the United States, we do not claim a right to prevent you from copying, distributing, performing, displaying or creating derivative works based on the work as long as all references to Project Gutenberg are removed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may remove Project Gutenberg references for public-domain works in the U.S., but removing references exempts you from complying with the license terms that apply when the Project Gutenberg name is retained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not unlink/detach or remove the full Project Gutenberg License (1.E.4)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not unlink or detach or remove the full Project Gutenberg License terms from this work, or any files containing a part of this work or any other work associated with Project Gutenberg.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The full license must remain attached to redistributed copies when the Project Gutenberg association is retained.

rubrics_metrics.name: Must comply with paragraphs 1.E.1–1.E.7 when retaining Project Gutenberg association (1.E.2/1.E.3)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you are redistributing or providing access to a work with the phrase "Project Gutenberg" associated with or appearing on the work, you must comply either with the requirements of paragraphs 1.E.1 through 1.E.7 or obtain permission for the use of the work and the Project Gutenberg trademark.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Retaining the Project Gutenberg name triggers the full set of redistribution obligations (including license sentence, not removing license, format/ASCII requirements, fee rules, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide original "Plain Vanilla ASCII" on request when converting formats (1.E.6)
rubrics_metrics.description: You may convert to and distribute this work in any ... form. However, if you provide access to or distribute copies of a Project Gutenberg work in a format other than "Plain Vanilla ASCII" ... you must, at no additional cost, provide a copy, a means of exporting a copy, or a means of obtaining a copy upon request, of the work in its original "Plain Vanilla ASCII" or other form. Any alternate format must include the full Project Gutenberg License.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not charge a fee unless specific fee-conditions are met (1.E.7/1.E.8)
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not charge a fee for access to, viewing, displaying, performing, copying or distributing any Project Gutenberg works unless you comply with paragraph 1.E.8 or 1.E.9.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Charging for Project Gutenberg works is prohibited except under strict conditions (see 1.E.8–1.E.9).

rubrics_metrics.name: Conditions for charging a fee (royalty & refund requirements) (1.E.8)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you charge a reasonable fee ... you must: pay a royalty fee of 20% of the gross profits ... provide a full refund to users who notify you within 30 days that they do not agree to the license terms; provide, under paragraph 1.F.3, a full refund or replacement for defective works reported within 90 days; and comply with all other terms for free distribution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commercial redistribution requires paying royalties, offering refunds under specified conditions, and complying with all license terms; royalty payments go to the trademark owner and are to be donated to the Foundation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Permission required for other charging/distribution arrangements (1.E.9)

If you are outside the United States, check the laws of your country in addition to the terms of this agreement before downloading, copying, displaying, performing, distributing or creating derivative works.
